newsitem.title: IRAQ: Saddam's son Uday walks on crutches - papers.
newsitem.headline: Saddam's son Uday walks on crutches - papers.

text.p: Iraq's newspapers published a picture on Tuesday showing President Saddam Hussein's eldest son Uday leaving hospital on crutches nearly six months after an assassination attempt.
In the picture, published in all Iraqi newspapers including Uday's Babel, he was accompanied by his younger brother Qusay and Iraqi doctors who treated him.
The official Iraqi News Agency had said on Monday Uday left Ibn Sinaa hospital in Baghdad after a "full recovery".
Uday was reported to have been seriously wounded by unidentified gunmen as he was driving on December 12 in Baghdad's wealthy district of al-Mansour.
He underwent several operations, the last in April on his left leg. Uday, who said he was hit in both legs, said after the last operation he expected to be on his feet in a few days or weeks.
A few days after the assassination attempt, Uday blamed Iraq. Tehran denied the charge.
